title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Ars Technica review
gist: Ars Technica's review of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI praises its technical polish, lighting, crowd simulation and Jason-Lucia relationship, which a reported billion-dollar budget and roughly a decade of work produced, while criticizing errand-like early missions, sophomoric humor and simple combat. The reviewer expects it to be a long-lived 'hang out' game and doubts this scale of effort will be seen again soon.
